title: Microbiome Assay
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5zmg746

steps.title: Prepare N2 Worms
steps.instruction: Prepare and synchronize N2 worms to ensure young adults are available for tracking days.

substeps.instruction: Chunk N2s on 3-4 plates on Wednesday.
Bleach the N2s on Friday and keep the tube in a rotator inside a 20°C incubator.
On Monday, refeed the arrested L1s so they become young adults on Thursday (Tracking Day 1).
On Tuesday, refeed the arrested L1s so they become young adults on Friday (Tracking Day 2).

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Cultures
steps.instruction: Grow and seed bacterial cultures for testing.

substeps.instruction: On Tuesday (for Thursday tracking) and Wednesday (for Friday tracking), inoculate a single colony in 100ml LB broth.
Grow the culture in a shaking incubator at 200-220rpm overnight.
On Wednesday morning (or Thursday morning for the second batch), seed 2 maintenance plates per strain with 100ul of the liquid culture.
Leave plates under the hood to dry.
Store the remaining bacterial culture in a falcon tube at 4°C for use the following day.

steps.title: Pre-condition L4 Worms
steps.instruction: Pre-condition L4 worms on seeded bacterial plates the day before tracking (Wednesday or Thursday).

substeps.instruction: Wash 2 plates of worms (refed on Monday or Tuesday) with M9.
Spin at 2500rpm for 2 mins.
Remove supernatant with a Pasteur pipette, leaving approximately 250ul in the tube.
Pipette about 20ul of L4s onto the seeded plates containing the bacteria to be tested.
Incubate at 20°C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare and seed plates for the tracking day.

substeps.instruction: Measure the OD of the bacterial culture stored at 4°C.
Match and record the starting ODs for cultures being tested on the same day.
Measure the weight of three imaging plates and record the average.
Label imaging plates according to the tracking plan.
Seed 12 plates with 20ul of each bacterial culture (6 for preconditioned L4s and 6 for young adults) and leave to dry.

steps.title: Process Young Adult Worms
steps.instruction: Prepare and transfer young adult worms to imaging plates.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2 plates with M9 and spin at 2500rpm for 2 mins.
Remove as much supernatant as possible.
Pipette the remaining worms onto an unseeded maintenance plate.
Once the M9 has dried, pick 5 adult worms onto each imaging plate and image immediately.

steps.title: Process Pre-conditioned L4 Worms
steps.instruction: Transfer pre-conditioned L4 worms to imaging plates.

substeps.instruction: Pick worms from their individual pre-conditioning plates onto imaging plates and image immediately.
